newsitem.title: USA: Gloucester County, Va., approves $10 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Gloucester County, Va., approves $10 mln bonds.

text.p: Gloucester County, Va., Industrial Development Authority authorized up to $10 million of revenue bonds to bring the first industry to the county's new business park, the Daily Press said Wednesday.
The authority's economic development director, Douglas Meredith, said he expects the actual issue size to be closer to $5 million but the higher authorization was sought for flexibility.
The revenue bonds will finance construction of a 102,000-square-foot building for Industrial Resources Technologies, a joint venture of Canon USA and Canon Virginia.
Bond proceeds will also be used to renovate a former department store building that Industrial Resources uses as headquarters.
The pass-through debt agreement calls for debt service to be paid from lease revenues from the building. The company has a 10-year lease with the firm, with an option to buy.
The sale is expected early next year.
